heading: EXT. FLOATING MARKET ON THE SKY-LAKE OF AELDRATH - DAWN

units.text: EXT. FLOATING MARKET ON THE SKY-LAKE OF AELDRATH - DAWN
Boats hang in the air on ropes of braided cloud.
Merchants shout over a sea of drifting lanterns.
Gulls the color of silver coins wheel overhead.
Far below, a moonlit ocean.
A skiff drifts toward the market's edge.
At its tiller sits THESSALONIKE VANTERPOOL-ORUNMILA (30s, battered leather coat, a cutlass at her belt).
Behind her, the apprentice-mage CORNELIUS ABRAHAM-WYNNE (19, ink-stained fingers, spellbook hugged).
Between them, hooded and silent, a cloaked woman waits: this is MORWENNA (age unknown, eyes like twin moons).
Hold on.
units.name: THESSALONIKE

units.text: To what?
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: Anything.
units.name: THESSALONIKE

units.text: The skiff slams into the dock.
Cornelius pitches forward and Morwenna catches him by the collar without opening her eyes.
Careful, child.
units.name: MORWENNA

units.text: I'm trying.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: Try harder.
units.name: MORWENNA

units.text: We have until noon. Cornelius, you find the spice merchant. Morwenna, the cloud-weaver. I'll find the passage.
units.name: THESSALONIKE

units.text: What passage?
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: The one that isn't on the map.
units.name: THESSALONIKE

units.text: It never is.
units.name: MORWENNA

units.text: They split.
Thessalonike weaves through the crowd, hand on her cutlass.
Cornelius ducks under a banner of dried starfish.
Morwenna drifts like smoke, unhurried, and stalls fall quiet as she passes.
At the spice stall, Cornelius meets a vendor with ten arms.
Everything he says comes out in a nervous rush.
Er, hello, I need saffron. The sky kind. Not the ground kind.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: At the weavers' stall, Morwenna lifts a veil of mist, and the old woman behind it kneels.
Don't. I am not what I was.
units.name: MORWENNA

units.text: Thessalonike, meanwhile, finds an iron door half-sunk in a wall of cloud.
She puts her palm on it.
It hums.
She grins.
There you are.
units.name: THESSALONIKE

units.text: Behind her, Cornelius and Morwenna arrive, panting, arms full of paper-wrapped parcels.
Got the saffron!
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: Got the weaving.
units.name: MORWENNA

units.text: Got the door.
units.name: THESSALONIKE

units.text: They stare at it.
The hum swells to a chord, and the iron door swings open on a stair of falling stars.
Is that safe?
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: Nothing is.
units.name: MORWENNA

units.text: Thessalonike steps through first.
Cornelius follows.
Morwenna pauses, glances back over the market, and whispers to the bright, indifferent sky.
Forgive us.
units.name: MORWENNA
